name: RC Stamped
description: Phase 4 — Validation and QA. Acceptance is validated and mandatory quality metrics pass before a release candidate is stamped.

requiredArtifacts.validation: All quality gates green or explicitly waived. RC stamped by QA Lead and Tech Lead.
Product Owner signs off on acceptance criteria verification
Zero High/Critical CVEs in production-bound artifacts; structure conforms to security-scan-report.schema.json
Every declared inter-component contract exercised; no FAIL entries without waiver; structure conforms to integration-evidence.schema.json
70% unit / 20% integration / 10% E2E target met or deviation explained

exitCriteria: All quality thresholds verified; security scans clean; UAT passed; release candidate formally approved.
